title: chat-server: channel destroy forbidden; Group admin-only updates and create fields
description: (a) Chat/set destroy of a channel returns forbidden (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L1049); chat.rs ~L904-940 goes straight to destroy_object with no kind check (forbidden only on create, L484). (b) Group name/description/avatarBlobId updates are admin-only with an allowlist of update keys (L1026-1030). (c) Group create accepts avatarBlobId and messageExpirySeconds and returns overQuota (L1010-1020). Space destroy manage_space is JMAP-wwwx (not repeated here); Space metadata updates are already gated (space.rs L1366, memory.rs L1136).
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Tests: channel destroy -> notDestroyed forbidden (L1049); non-admin Group name update -> forbidden; disallowed update key rejected; Group create with avatarBlobId/messageExpirySeconds round-trips; over quota -> overQuota (L1010-1020).
close_reason: Landed in 39f3ac25 fix(chat-server): enforce Chat/set per-kind rules (batch 5, adversarially verified, CI green at 44026b06)
